smap.spatialSupport: 9 km EASE-Grid posting; approximately 36 km radiometer footprint, ~33 km interpolation contributing domain. Cells are correlated, not field measurements.
smap.qa: Require retrieval bits 0 and 1 clear, surface flag zero, finite in-range non-fill moisture and valid observation time. Error fill remains null.

imerg.spatialSupport: Native 0.1 degree grid; merged/interpolated estimates, not a field rain gauge.
imerg.qa: Reject fill, nonfinite and negative rates. Retain quality index as qualitative metadata, no invented calibrated acceptance threshold. Random error is product RMS estimate, not a calibrated interval.

rootZone.spatialSupport: 9 km EASE-Grid land-model assimilation; surface 0–5 cm and root zone 0–100 cm vertical averages. Not field measurements.
rootZone.qa: Finite, non-fill values within file valid range. No retrieval flag applies to these model outputs. GPH has no selected soil-moisture uncertainty fields; AUP diagnostics not acquired.
rootZone.reason: One three-hour mean only; surface and root-zone values are model-assimilation estimates, not direct retrievals.

limitations: Only this bounded day is captured; no seasonal completeness, anomalies or agronomic calibration.
No resampling to field scale, gap filling, exposure classification, POWER replacement or scoring changes.
IMERG and POWER share MERRA-2-related inputs. L4 metadata lists IMGv7BFnCPCUcorrv3 precipitation forcing; L4 and IMERG agreement is not independent confirmation.
Do not sum random errors as independent; temporal and spatial error dependence is unresolved.

provenance.timePolicy: IMERG uses actual time_bnds, half-open UTC intervals; seconds since 1980-01-06 with no leap seconds per file metadata. SMAP L3 uses per-cell tb_time_utc, not nominal 6am. L4 uses explicit Metadata/Extent UTC bounds for three-hour means; raw J2000 time is retained and not naively converted as Unix time.
provenance.packing: Native floating values; no scale/offset attributes (implicit 1/0) verified. cm3/cm3 numerically equals m3/m3.
provenance.geometryPolicy: IMERG native bounds; SMAP local adjacent-coordinate midpoint cell outlines are approximate, not footprint boundaries.
provenance.credentialHandling: Credentials loaded only by acquisition process; no secrets or signed URLs in archive.
